name: trust-chain
description: Trust chain and attestation management by MEOK AI Labs.

tools.name: create_trust_anchor
tools.description: Create a new trust anchor (root of trust) for an entity.

tools.name: verify_chain
tools.description: Verify the integrity of a trust chain by validating all attestations.

tools.name: add_attestation
tools.description: Add an attestation (claim) to an existing trust anchor.

tools.name: get_trust_score
tools.description: Calculate a composite trust score for an anchor based on its attestations.

tools.name: revoke_trust
tools.description: Revoke a trust anchor or attestation. This invalidates the chain.
